visualHierarchyIssues: The primary button icon (arrow pointing right) violates RTL layout standards, where right-pointing arrows indicate backward/back navigation instead of forward/submit.

Mixed English/Arabic string in input placeholder lacks explicit bidi isolation, causing improper character clipping on smaller screen widths.
uxHeuristics: Exposing developer implementation details ('Supabase Auth') in the main subtitle and footer badge increases cognitive load for university employees.
